Escavalier

Bug Steel

Unova · Generation 5

Escavalier is a Bug/Steel-type Cavalry Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 1 m tall and weighs 33 kg. It evolves from Karrablast. Its highest base stat is Attack (135), with a base stat total of 495.
